       m2.name AS model2, m2.first_flight AS first_flight2,
       CASE 
         WHEN m1.first_flight > m2.first_flight THEN m1.name
         WHEN m2.first_flight > m1.first_flight THEN m2.name
         ELSE 'Same first flight date'
       END AS later_first_flight
"
